description: Store-operations VP gives an approved budget, says she signs, and accepts a pilot-planning slot.

turns.text: So, last time you said the shift-swap problem was the big one. Where did the pilot land with your managers?
They loved it, honestly. Two of the district managers asked when they can have it everywhere.
That's great to hear. Have you been able to get budget lined up for the wider rollout?
Yeah, we've got eighty-five thousand approved for the rollout. That came through last week.
Perfect. And on your side, who signs the order form?
That's me. I sign off on anything in store ops, and this sits in my area.
Got it. Could we do Thursday at 10 to plan the rollout waves?
Thursday at 10 is perfect, put it on my calendar.
